name: Tidy
tagline: Clean up your screen with one click before sharing
title: Hide desktop clutter in one click before you share your screen
intro: Right before you share your screen on a video call, hide messy desktop icons and windows you don't want people to see. When you're done, one more click puts everything back.
points: Cover your desktop icons and wallpaper with a solid color (your Windows settings are never changed)
Minimize every window except the one you're using
Hide the taskbar
Click Restore to bring your screen back exactly as it was. Even if the app closes unexpectedly, it restores everything the next time it starts
scene: Before sharing your screen on Zoom, Teams or Google Meet. Before taking a screenshot or recording your screen.

name: Notes
title: A notepad that's always one edge away
intro: Jot something down without leaving what you're doing. No opening Notepad, saving a file, and closing it again.
points: Start typing the moment it opens
Saves automatically as you type
Copy or delete notes. Deleted notes can be restored for 7 days
Your notes stay on this PC. Nothing is sent anywhere
scene: Notes during a meeting, a phone number someone reads out, something to look up later.

name: Music
tagline: Control Spotify, YouTube and more from anywhere
title: Control Spotify or YouTube from the edge of your screen
intro: Pause, skip, or go back without switching to your music app. Works with the Spotify app, YouTube, and most apps that show music in Windows media controls.
points: Play, pause, previous and next for Spotify and other music apps
See the song, artist and album art
For YouTube, also see the whole playlist with thumbnails and pick a song (with the Hashikko Player extension for Chrome)
Works from the edge of the screen, whatever app you're in
scene: When you have background music playing while you write, study or code.

name: Timer
title: A focus timer at the edge of your screen
intro: Work for 25 minutes, rest for 5. Use focus-and-break intervals like the Pomodoro Technique without opening another app.
points: Switch between Focus and Break
Set any length from 1 to 90 minutes
The panel changes color when time is up
Counts your focus sessions for the day
scene: Studying, writing, or getting through chores.

name: Calculator
tagline: Quick math, then copy the answer
title: A calculator at the edge of your screen. Calculate, then copy the answer
intro: No need to hunt for the Calculator app. Open it from the edge, do the math, and copy the answer straight into what you're writing.
points: Add, subtract, multiply, divide and percent
Works with your keyboard too
"Copy answer" puts the result on your clipboard
scene: Quotes and budgets, splitting a bill, checking numbers while you build a spreadsheet.

name: To-do
tagline: Write it down, check it off
title: The simplest to-do list: write it down, check it off
intro: A to-do list with nothing to set up. Add a task, check it off when it's done.
points: Type and press Enter to add
Click to check off, click again to undo
Clear all finished tasks at once
scene: Today's work, a shopping list, things to finish before a meeting.

name: Word count
tagline: Count words and characters in any text
title: Count words and characters, just by pasting
intro: Check the length of an essay, cover letter or post without pasting it into a website.
points: Words and characters (with and without spaces)
Lines
Estimated reading time
scene: Essays with a word limit, application forms, social media posts.

name: World clock
tagline: See the time in other cities
title: See the time and time difference in other cities at a glance
intro: Before you call family or message a coworker abroad, check what time it is there.
points: Your local time at the top
Add or remove cities from a list of 15
Shows the date and the time difference from you
scene: Scheduling meetings across time zones, calling family overseas.
